facts.text: Lancaster’s name origin is unclear, attributed to a railroad clerk, a railroad official’s nickname, or a settler’s Pennsylvania hometown.
The Museum of Art and History operates four sites across Lancaster, Antelope Valley, and neighboring counties, showcasing regional culture and history.
A stretch of road in Lancaster grooves to play the finale of the William Tell Overture once you hit 55 mph, a relic of a Honda ad campaign.
Downtown’s historic buildings and modern amenities form the Lancaster Old Town Site, a blend of heritage and contemporary life.
In 2012, the Lancaster JetHawks captured their first California League Championship, a milestone for the local baseball community.
